scope: Actual arm64 iOS Simulator mprotect startup failure, source-pinned repair and successful repaired JVM initialization; physical-device cause remains unknown.

observed.vmOutput:
Error occurred during initialization of VM
Could not reserve enough space in CodeCache (160K)
observed.actualErrno: Permission denied (text emitted by JVM; numeric errno not printed)

lines4to8: Error occurred during initialization of VM
Could not reserve enough space in CodeCache (160K)
syscallEvidence.directObservation: 32 MiB reservation succeeded; mprotect for its first 160 KiB failed with Permission denied. The initial CodeCache commit failed before VM initialization completed.
syscallEvidence.protectionFlags: The trace does not print prot bits; RWX is established by the pinned source call chain below.

candidateMechanism.failureSite: CodeCache::add_heap rejects CodeHeap::reserve failure. This is not the distinct reserve_heap_memory error.
candidateMechanism.reservationMetadata: CodeMemoryReserver originally always passes ExecMem, preserved by ReservedSpace and VirtualSpace.
candidateMechanism.initialCommit: The BSD Apple executable commit calls mprotect with PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC. The pinned iOS anonymous reservation omits MAP_JIT.
candidateMechanism.alternativeFailure: Resolved for diagnostic run 39043099245: direct trace identifies mprotect permission denial during initial commit rather than reservation or segment-map failure.
candidateMechanism.zeroExecution: The Zero cache stores ZeroEntry structures and static C++ function addresses. invoke calls the saved function address; native_entry uses precompiled ffi_call and signature metadata.
candidateMechanism.boundary: This audit covers the exercised Zero/JNI path, not every libffi closure or Foreign API upcall.

repair.change: Pass !ExecMem only for iOS Zero code reservations, preserving the same non-executable metadata through subsequent commits and growth.
repair.runtimeValidation: Actual Simulator JNI_CreateJavaVM returned 0 in run 39042657077 (4.725756 seconds); session creation, runtime diagnostics and close succeeded. The full fixture remained blocked by a separate missing legacy bytecode verifier.

sources.finding: Observed error text and CodeHeap reserve failure site.
VirtualSpace preserves executable metadata for future commits.
Executable Apple commit requests RWX through mprotect.
ZeroEntry stores a precompiled entry address.
invoke calls the saved entry pointer instead of executing the structure.
Static C++ call_stub and empty continuation/compiler generators.
